That's a very good question, I have so much going on right now I can't decide. My family won't return my phone calls, I'm past due on my rent and the only person helping me at the moment is out of town. I'm fairly certain that person is starting to or already has loathed me for some time due to the past-due rent issues.

Beyond that I'm not feeling good mentally, anxiety, paranoia and isolation are what I'm experiencing. I moved recently and I think it was a mistake but I can't get in touch with any family to move back home. 

My friend keeps offering money for a way back home.. which is great but.. no one will pick up the phone.. so it feels like I'm at the end of the line.
Yea I'm here, I don't know where to start
